description: This Java class 'AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter' is responsible for starting and managing Akka Actor instances that handle acknowledgment forwarding within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes logic for creating actors with unique names, managing acknowledgment requests, and handling duplicate correlation IDs, indicating its role in orchestrating asynchronous acknowledgment processing.

classes.name: AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter
classes.description: A class responsible for starting and managing acknowledgment forwarding actors within an Akka-based system, including handling acknowledgment requests, actor naming, and duplicate ID handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the starter for a given actor context, entity ID, signal, acknowledgment configuration, and acknowledgment label predicate.

methods.name: getAllowedAckRequests
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgment requests permitted for this actor starter, filtering out requests not allowed in the current context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Attempts to start an acknowledgment forwarder actor if there are effective acknowledgment requests, returning an Optional ActorRef.

methods.name: getConflictFree
methods.description: Generates a new, conflict-free correlation ID and starts the acknowledgment forwarder actor if acknowledgment requests are present.

methods.name: joinPrefixAndCounter
methods.description: Concatenates a prefix and counter to generate a unique correlation ID component.

methods.name: parseCorrelationId
methods.description: Parses the correlation ID from headers into a prefix and number component, generating a UUID if absent.

methods.name: startAckForwarderActor
methods.description: Starts an acknowledgment forwarder actor with the provided headers.

methods.name: getDuplicateCorrelationIdException
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating duplicate correlation IDs.

methods.name: declineAllNonDittoAckRequests
methods.description: Responds with NACKs for acknowledgment requests with labels not defined by Ditto.

methods.name: getNack
methods.description: Constructs a NACK acknowledgment message for a given label and exception.
